title: PsyMo: A Dataset for Estimating Self-Reported Psychological Traits from Gait
reasoning: The paper focuses on psychological traits such as personality, self-esteem, fatigue, aggression, and mental health using standard psychological questionnaires (Big Five, Rosenberg Self-Esteem, Buss-Perry Aggression, Occupational Fatigue Exhaustion/Recovery Scale, DASS-21, and General Health Questionnaire). It does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics as its primary subject matter. The 'Legal and Ethical Considerations' section discusses data collection ethics, not the content of ethical frameworks or beliefs.
